definitions.ask: Should the Agents tab still point at stranded beads that have no loaded agent row?
definitions.why: Keeps the always-visible strip honest while still leading to the backlog on demand

choices.label: Only the ,j triple-miss toast names the project-wide count and where to find it
The info strip also appends a dim `+N in Beads` suffix when a backlog exists
The Agents tab never mentions unsurfaced stranded beads; only the Beads pane counts them

definitions.ask: Add a `status:stranded` filter to the Beads pane so the stranded backlog can be listed?
definitions.why: Without it the ~140 legacy stranded beads have no worklist anywhere in the TUI
